result.summary: The page is generally visually coherent. One minor layout issue is visible in the top header.

issues.description: The notification bell is positioned very close to the right screen edge, with noticeably less right-side padding than the left padding used for the delivery-location content. This makes the header feel slightly unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Align the notification button to the same horizontal page gutter as the delivery-location section, or use consistent header padding on both sides.
